fusions.name: Counted Strokes
fusions.desc: Strikes the target for 8 damage, leaves it 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Flawless Swath
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Fresh Edge
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Gleaner's Second Pass
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
